summary.text: Mary Beth Canty has represented the 54th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: She is an attorney and consultant with a B.A. from William & Mary and a J.D. from the University of Arizona.

The legislature biography lists her as an Arlington Heights Village Board member and a former member of the board of directors of the Regional Transportation Authority, and says she lives in Arlington Heights.
